b2-17.title: A new outfit
b2-17.story: Anna had a school party on Friday and needed a new [[outfit]]. She went to the market with Lisa, who has strong opinions about clothes. First, Lisa held up a pair of [[baggy]] jeans made of soft [[denim]]. "Too relaxed for a party," Anna said, laughing. Then she tried a white [[tank top]] under a gray [[cardigan]], but it was made of scratchy [[polyester]]. Next, Lisa found a smart [[blazer]] in [[khaki]], and it fit Anna perfectly. On the way out, Anna also grabbed a light jacket made of [[nylon]] in case it rained. At the party, Max wore his favorite [[beanie]] indoors, and everyone teased him. Anna just smiled, because for once she felt completely comfortable.

b2-18.title: Smart shopping deals
b2-18.story: Anna wanted new headphones, but she was trying to save money. Earlier that week she had made a [[deposit]] at the bank, so her birthday money was finally on her card. Max, who loves a good deal, offered to help her shop smart. They found a [[low-cost]] online store that offered free returns. Anna had a [[coupon]] for ten percent off, and her aunt had given her a gift [[voucher]] as well. Max did the math: the sale price, [[plus]] delivery, was still under her budget. He even pulled an old American [[dime]] out of his wallet and joked that it was his contribution. Two days later, a [[courier]] knocked on the door with a small box. The headphones sounded amazing, so Anna bought Max an ice cream to say thanks.

b2-19.title: At the beauty salon
b2-19.story: Sofia was going to a concert on Saturday, so she booked an appointment at a small beauty [[salon]] near her house. Anna came along to keep her company. The makeup artist started with a thin line of black [[eyeliner]] and then added a little [[mascara]]. Sofia wanted her hair to stay in place all night, so the hairdresser used some [[gel]] and a strong hair [[spray]]. When Anna coughed, the hairdresser opened a window and explained that an [[aerosol]] can should never be used near a heater or a flame. Next door, a girl was getting a tiny [[tattoo]] of a star on her wrist. Sofia admired it, but for now she only asked about getting a second ear [[piercing]] next month. When she finally looked in the mirror, she barely recognized herself, in the best possible way.

b2-20.title: A luxury jewelry shop
b2-20.story: For Mama's birthday, Anna and her dad visited a jewelry shop that looked like pure [[luxury]] inside. The assistant showed them a necklace with a single [[pearl]] and a ring with a deep blue [[sapphire]]. Dad looked at the price tag and quietly asked if they had anything less expensive. The assistant pointed to the [[premium]] collection, which was still beautiful but more affordable. Anna noticed a pair of [[crystal]] earrings that sparkled in the light. However, when she looked closer, she found a tiny [[defect]] on one of them, so the assistant brought a new pair. She wrapped them in a [[deluxe]] gift box with a silk ribbon. On the way home, a man on the street offered Dad a "designer" watch, but Dad laughed and said it was obviously a [[fake]]. Mama loved the earrings so much that she wore them to her birthday dinner that evening.

b2-21.title: A student fashion week
b2-21.story: Sofia dreams of becoming a [[fashion designer]], so Anna got them tickets to a student [[fashion show]] in Kyiv. On the way, they stopped outside a small [[boutique]] to look at the window. A [[mannequin]] there was wearing a dress made from a bright Ukrainian [[textile]]. Inside the hall, a well-known [[supermodel]] opened the evening in a long green coat. Afterward, Sofia met a [[stylist]] who had been fixing the models' hair at incredible speed. She gave Sofia a [[catalog]] of the collection and some advice: "Draw every day, even when it's hard." On the bus home, Sofia filled three pages of her sketchbook with new ideas.

b2-22.title: Shopping for winter clothes
b2-22.story: Winter was coming, so Anna and Ira took the bus to the [[outlet center]] outside the city. Ira admits she is a total [[shopaholic]], so Anna had made a strict list. First on the list was a warm [[parka]] with a fur hood, which Anna found at half price. Ira immediately picked up a gray [[zip hoodie]] and a [[crop top]] that she definitely didn't need. Anna wanted new pants and tried on some beige [[chinos]], but the [[slim fit]] felt too tight. She chose a relaxed pair instead, and an [[oversize]] sweater to go with them. The sweater was [[unisex]], so Taras would probably borrow it. At the checkout, the cashier couldn't scan the [[barcode]] on one of Ira's things, and they had to wait ten minutes. Ira took it as a sign and put half of her things back on the shelf.

b2-23.title: Street style photos
b2-23.story: On Saturday, Max and Anna went out with Lisa's cousin, a [[fashion photographer]] who takes pictures of [[street style]] around Kyiv. Max carried her heavy camera in his [[rucksack]]. The first person she photographed was a skater with a red [[bandana]] tied around his neck. Then a cyclist lifted the [[visor]] of his helmet and smiled for the camera. It was a cold day, and a young man in a knitted [[balaclava]] said it was the warmest thing he owned. A girl in an elegant silk [[hijab]] had matched it with bright yellow sneakers. Her friend proudly showed off her [[nail art]], tiny painted sunflowers on every finger. Last, they met a musician in the park wearing a huge [[sombrero]] and playing guitar. That evening, the cousin posted the photos online, and the musician's picture got the most likes.

b2-24.title: Smart home gadgets
b2-24.story: Anna's dad loves gadgets, so last month he turned their house into a smart home. Now a [[thermostat]] on the wall controls the heating, and you can change it from a [[touchscreen]] in the kitchen. A motion [[sensor]] in the hallway turns on the lights whenever Taras walks past. Dad also put a smoke [[detector]] in every room, and it once went off when Anna burned toast. On Tuesday evening, everything suddenly went dark because of a [[blackout]] across the neighborhood. Dad's phone showed an [[alert]] from the power company, and the old [[generator]] in the garage started with a loud roar. A quiet [[beep]] told them the [[boiler]] was working again, so at least they had hot water. In the confusion, their cat ran out the open door, but luckily he has a [[microchip]] with Dad's phone number. A neighbor found him an hour later, and Taras decided the cat was the smartest gadget in the house.
